assumptions: Validate extraction, transport, and fuel-handling unlocks before choosing machinery; complete any additional required research before construction.

Exit with natural copper automatically mined, smelted, fueled, and routed toward science assembly at the required rate.

Exit with powered science assembly automatically receiving copper and gears and extracting finished packs into adequate storage or consumption capacity. Do not apply building-stock caps to science.

steps.description: Acquire 20 coal as startup fuel for the copper mining and smelting cell.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather the missing 20 coal as a finite manual startup batch; preserve the held drill, furnace, and eight iron plates.
execution_guidance.rationale: No fuel is held. A small startup batch enables the existing machines without investing in an automated coal route before power and transport choices are grounded.
constraints: Coal is startup fuel, not the final automatic fuel supply.
Gather only the deficit to 20 held coal.
Do not consume the held machines or iron for optional expansion.

steps.description: Place the held burner-mining-drill over natural copper ore and obtain its live identity and actual output position.

execution_guidance.approach: Validate copper mining compatibility and coverage, then install the one held burner drill using a legal resource-bound candidate.
execution_guidance.rationale: Choose direct feeding: the drill and furnace are already held, so no additional cell fabrication is needed. Repeated copper demand favors avoiding hand mining and repeated ore transfers.
constraints: Read live copper mining facts before assigning a production duration.
Stop for the placed drill identity and actual output geometry.

steps.description: Place the held stone-furnace at a validated position covering the drill output and obtain its live identity.

execution_guidance.approach: Validate copper smelting compatibility and place the held furnace using the observed drill output as the required covered position.
execution_guidance.rationale: Reuse the held furnace as a dedicated direct-fed copper cell. A shared hand-fed furnace saves no building here and would add ore handling and later recipe-switching work.
constraints: Use the drill's observed output, not inferred orientation.
A placement count proves presence only.
Obtain the furnace identity before exact fuel supply or output checks.

steps.description: Fuel the copper cell, verify direct ore delivery, collect 10 newly smelted copper plates, and verify electronics researched.

execution_guidance.approach: Fuel both exact machines from the startup stock, verify the direct-output relationship, and collect 10 copper plates while checking electronics.
execution_guidance.rationale: The live requirement is 10 smelted copper plates, not hand crafting. One held cell avoids expansion cost; defer scale-out until measured remaining work justifies additional machines.
constraints: Fuel the drill and furnace independently; add only a proven fuel deficit if needed.
Bind completion to 10 held copper plates and electronics researched.
Verify actual ore delivery and plate output; placement alone is insufficient.
